name: C1.1 Patients missing required demographic fields (sex, birth year, race or ethnicity)
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE p.gender_concept_id IS NULL OR p.year_of_birth IS NULL OR p.race_concept_id IS NULL OR p.ethnicity_concept_id IS NULL

name: C1.2 Patients with a non-standard, invalid or wrong-domain concept for sex, diagnosis or sample type
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE (p.gender_concept_id <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concept c WHERE c.concept_id = p.gender_concept_id AND c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL AND c.domain_id = 'Gender')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concept c WHERE c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id AND c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL AND c.domain_id = 'Condition')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id AND s.specimen_concept_id <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concept c WHERE c.concept_id = s.specimen_concept_id AND c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL AND c.domain_id = 'Specimen'))

name: CO2.1 Patients without a primary tumour diagnosis or without any sample
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id)

name: CO2.2 Patients with a missing or unmapped diagnosis, diagnosis date, vital status date or sample date
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND (co.condition_concept_id = 0 OR co.condition_start_date IS NULL)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id AND op.observation_period_end_date IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id AND s.specimen_date IS NULL)

name: P3.1 Patients with a diagnosis or sample dated before their birth year, or an observation period that ends before it starts
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) < p.year_of_birth) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.specimen_date) < p.year_of_birth) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id AND op.observation_period_end_date < op.observation_period_start_date)

name: P3.2 Patients with an implausible birth year (before 1900 or in the future) or age at diagnosis (under 18 or over 100)
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE p.year_of_birth < 1900 OR p.year_of_birth > EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth < 18 OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) - p.year_of_birth > 100))

name: CC4.1 Patients with a diagnosis or sample outside their observation period
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = co.person_id AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = s.person_id AND s.specimen_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date))

name: CC4.2 Patients whose tumour location code does not match the documented mapping (value mapping table B)
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES ('C 18.0 - Caecum', 432837), ('C 18.1 - Appendix', 433143), ('C 18.2 - Ascending colon', 4247719), ('C 18.3 - Hepatic flexure', 438979), ('C 18.4 - Transverse colon', 432257), ('C 18.5 - Splenic flexure', 437798), ('C 18.6 - Descending colon', 441800), ('C 18.7 - Sigmoid colon', 436635), ('C 19 - Rectosigmoid junction', 438699), ('C 20 - Rectum', 74582)) AS m(source_value, concept_id) WHERE m.source_value = co.condition_source_value AND m.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id))

name: CU5.1 Patients with records dated after the data release date
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_start_date > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_release_date), CURRENT_DATE) FROM cdm_source)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = p.person_id AND s.specimen_date > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_release_date), CURRENT_DATE) FROM cdm_source)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id AND op.observation_period_end_date > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_release_date), CURRENT_DATE) FROM cdm_source))

name: CU5.2 Specimen not collected within one year of primary diagnosis
description: Patients with at least one specimen, but none collected within one year of their first (primary) diagnosis year. Reports the share of patients affected; 0% means the check passed.
query:
WITH dx AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS dx_date
  FROM condition_occurrence
  GROUP BY person_id
)
SELECT dx.person_id
FROM dx
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specimen s WHERE s.person_id = dx.person_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM specimen s
    WHERE s.person_id = dx.person_id
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.specimen_date)
          BETWEEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dx.dx_date) - 1
              AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dx.dx_date) + 1
  );
